quest.title: This Novel Is Amazing!
quest.description: Chang the Ninth has written a brand new novel, and he's looking for someone who is able to take it to Feiyun Commerce Guild as fast as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: This time I am going to win...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Win what?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I don't know if you're aware, but there is a creative writing competition held periodically in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I believe the name is... "This Novel is Amazing!" More importantly, the competition is hosted by the Yae Publishing House, a giant of the Inazuma publishing industry.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I prepared for this competition by immersing myself in some Inazuma popular fiction to get a sense of what they like over there.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Of course, I also have an entire study full of literature and I've read every single book in there at some point in my life. So for my entry, I wrote a novel that integrates the best of Liyue and Inazuma culture. This one is a winner, I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I spoke with the Feiyun Commerce Guild. They are sending someone to take my entry to Inazuma and submit it in person. However, that someone has so far failed to show up!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I need you to deliver the manuscript to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Feiyun Commerce Guild</color> for me. Do you have the time?

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: That's the spirit. Go and make me a winner!

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: This is a competition. Sorry, but I am not about to let you in on the details of my entry.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: If I can just win this, everything will start to improve...

talks.objective: Take the book to Feiyun Commerce Guild

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That looks like the <color=#00E1FFFF>Feiyun Commerce Guild</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just hand the book to that <color=#00E1FFFF>guy at the entrance</color>. Job done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although... Paimon reeeally wants to know what the big deal with this book is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaddya think? Shall we take a sneak peek?

talks.objective: Take the book to Feiyun Commerce Guild

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a quick one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! Super-duper quick. Open it, open it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... This young boy, d'you reckon it's just Chang the Ninth himself?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Because as grumpy old men go, he's pretty young at heart, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd probably better get this book to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Feiyun Commerce Guild</color> now.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Where has the master gone this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have a book from Chang the Ninth.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Seriously, he still writes?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Oh... I remember now, he said something about entering a novel-writing competition in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: What did he write about this time, then? Last time he wrote a book about the Qixing and kept insisting that we publish it for him.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Even without it being published, I still almost had the Millelith on my case...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: At least this time it's going all the way to Inazuma for a competition. They probably wouldn't be able to trace it back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Give it here. I'll get one of the sailors bound for Inazuma to take it with them.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: I don't think Chang stands a chance of winning though. I hear a novel called "A Legend of Sword" is all the rage in Inazuma right now.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: The author of that one is also from Liyue, though I don't know who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing the book. Chang the Ninth had originally asked us to collect it, he'd even paid up front. Please take this for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Definitely going to win. Definitely...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I am going to win this, and then my book is going to be sold all around the world... And then, she will read it... She is sure to...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: ...What are you still doing here? Get my book down to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Feiyun Commerce Guild</color>, now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No peeking!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, spoilsport... You're right though, we're technically not supposed to look at it without him saying so.
